slot_note: architecture 3, re-rooted to another world and dataset on 2026-11-13 on the author's word (v2 spent: its deciding steps on or next to the client's closed page, stump strategy blocked against task4 v12): a Norwegian hydro generator sizes its committed margin facility for 2027 on the largest cumulative net cash outflow its exchange hedge book would face in a year whose prices and inflows repeat 2022
niche: a hydro generator's exchange hedge book and the committed facility that funds its margin and delivery settlements, sized on a stress year replayed on the 2027 book
analyst_test: A careful but hurried pass rebuilds the open book from the trade log, replays 2022's percentage moves on it day by day with the clearing house's margin rates scaled by price, nets the hedged output at spot and lands near the book's own 2022 outflow scaled to 2027; it misses that the desk keeps selling ahead of the ladder when prices run above budget, that the clearing house resets rates from its own volatility estimate with a review band and a floor, that each quarter cascades into front months that carry higher rates and move more, that the hedged output is paid five to seven weeks after the month, and that a reservoir opening low cuts a dry year's output below the hedged volume.
domain_test: Liquidity risk of a commodity hedge program: margin is cash now while the hedged output is cash later, the clearing house's margin rates follow its own volatility estimate, futures cascade into front months that move most, and hydro output falls with the reservoir in the dry years that lift prices; swap the nouns for a retailer's FX hedge or a bank's loan book and the cascade, the margin algorithm, the reservoir and the delivery settlement stop making sense.
layer2_pattern: own: a stress year replayed on a forward hedge book whose size, contract mix, margin rates, hedged output and cash timing each respond to the stress through their own process
layer1: a trade log with amendments, cancellations, give-ups between two clearing accounts and quantities in MW per hour on some rows and MWh on others
positions reported by the clearing house only at month ends after cascades, under contract codes the trade log does not use
margin statements with restated days and a holiday calendar
settlement prices with missing days, an exchange code change and a duplicated week
weekly inflows and reservoir levels with a gauge outage and provisional weeks revised later
a sales ledger with credit notes, part payments and one customer moved to a new account number
stakeholder_role: treasurer of a hydro generator preparing the board risk committee's renewal of the committed margin facility for 2027

spine.entity: one listed contract's daily settlement price
spine.source: simulated by task20/generator (a seeded Nordic-style power market, hydrology and one generator); no public data

world.org_type: hydro generator hedging its output on a Nordic-style power exchange (all names fictional)

driver: The decisive quantity is the largest cumulative net cash outflow of a hedge book through a replayed stress year, where the book's size, the contracts it sits in, the clearing house's margin rates, the hedged output and the timing of the cash that output brings in each respond to the stress through their own process, so each is rebuilt from its own record and replayed day by day rather than carried from the opening state or scaled from the stress year's own outcome.
driver_concrete: Hallingvass Kraft's board renews the committed margin facility for 2027 at the largest cumulative net cash outflow the hedge book would face in a year whose prices and inflows repeat 2022: the book grows as the desk sells ahead of the ladder above budget, quarters cascade into front months with higher rates and larger moves, NEX Clearing resets its rates from its own volatility estimate with a review band and a floor, the hedged output is paid weeks after delivery, and a reservoir opening low cuts the dry year's output below the hedged volume.
stump: The opening book with 2022's moves and constant margin rates, the output netted at spot, gives a facility near the current one; each of the five processes (the desk's response, the cascade, the margin algorithm, the receipts' timing, the reservoir-dependent output) moves the peak by more than the golden family's spread, and the shortcuts land on different wrong sizes.
results: R1 the open book at 31 December 2026 by delivery month (assembly); R2 the desk's hedge ratio as a function of price against budget, and the 2027 book through the replay (modeling); R3 NEX Clearing's margin-rate rule recovered from its rate history (measurement); R4 the margin path through the replay (modeling); R5 output in the replayed year from the opening reservoir (forecasting); R6 the receipts' timing from the sales ledger (assembly); R7 the peak cumulative net outflow and its date (synthesis); R8 the method replayed on the 2022 book against 2022's statements (self-verification); R9 the facility size bridged from the opening-book figure (decomposition)
one_fact_test: the largest single hint (the desk sells ahead of the ladder above budget, or rates follow the clearing house's own volatility estimate) rescues one result each, at most 2 of 9 with its dependents

lineage.why: the determinism judge's isolated first pass (medium effort, before the answer blocks) replicated the engine, found the extracts' cutoff by reconciling product control's hypothetical P&L and executed the add-on path from the standard; the careful column priced near 95
lineage.driver: The decisive quantities are the outcomes the forecast was actually about, rebuilt from the prior holdings rather than the booked totals, and each miss's survival under counterfactual forecasts that each restore one thing production lacked (the inputs it should have read, the components it left out, a scale that follows the recent spread), with the misses charged in a fixed order so the classes add back to the whole population of misses.

lineage.niche: Alpha research (finding and validating return-predictive signals): a card-transaction panel nowcast of a home-furnishings retailer's holiday-quarter revenue three weeks before it reports, with a range that has held on past quarters

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a revenue the record does not yet hold, estimated from a sample whose members can be re-keyed between sources without any note, so a unit present in both periods is not the same unit; the sample measures what is paid while the target books it later and excludes a component paid outside the sample, whose base period held a one-off; and the range is earned on past origins that could not see any of the three at this size.
